messages:
tara: Quick heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window in us-east1: rolling NIC firmware + soft reboot for pool 'helios-3' on Thu 03:30-05:30 UTC. Affected ~140 GPUs across 4 racks.
jin: What's the rollback criteria? any customer-facing SLOs impacted?
tara: Rollback if 5xx rate increases >2% for 3 continuous minutes or p95 latency >250ms for >5m. Dedicated capacity will be drained first; hosted will be routed to local quantized fallback when allowed.
liam: Quantized fallback sounds good. Are we gating by model type? embed-only tenants?
kai: embed-only should stay in-region; it's mostly CPU-safe. Generation-heavy customers we might shift.
marco: Cost check: if we cross-region failover to us-west for 30m, estimate egress ~900GB @ $0.09/GB = $81 plus spot backfill ~$280. If we use quantized in-region, cost delta ~ $40 for extra compute. Recommend in-region quantized unless SLA.
ops-oncall: Oncall will be present. I'll run egress watch and queue-depth alert. Tag me and @sre-bot for any escalation.
sre-bot: AUTO: Canary traffic will start on rack-1 at +12m (3% traffic). Auto-rollback on 4% error bump.
tara: There's a BMC flapping note on rack-3 from last week, ticket #2109. We'll reorder: rack-2 -> 1 -> 4 -> 3. If BMC unstable we will skip 3 and schedule follow-up.
jin: KV cache warmup plan? last cold-warm observed large seq regressions for convo models.
tara: Plan: after each rack reboot, run kv-warm with parallel=12 for top 50 tenants, then ramp traffic over 10m. If warmup fails, fallback to quantized for non-SLA.
liam: Can we compress firmware steps to avoid multiple reboots? microcode + NIC fw can be staged together?
tara: Yes, combined patching to do single soft reboot per rack. Saves ~10m rack time. Updated runbook below.

Runbook (snippet):
```bash
# cordon
redwood infra cordon --pool helios-3 --rack rack-2
# drain
redwood infra drain --rack rack-2 --timeout 600
# apply fw
redwood infra fw-apply --rack rack-2 --nic nic-v3.0.2 --microcode mc-1.4.0 --mode staged
# soft reboot
redwood infra reboot --rack rack-2 --type soft
# kv warm
redwood infra kv-warm --rack rack-2 --tenants top50 --parallel 12
# uncordon
redwood infra uncordon --rack rack-2
```
marco: tagging cost center MAINT-4890 and creating billing note.
ops-oncall: Small FYI: network team runs a BGP refresh Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC in us-east1; overlap risk. Tara, can you push our window 90m later if network refresh can't be moved?
tara: Good catch. I'll confirm with network. If they don't move, shift to 05:00-07:00 UTC. Will post update 36h before.
liam: I'll schedule a short perf run post-rack-4 to validate token throughput + tail. ping if you need extra canary traffic.
kai: Also, update the support email draft for non-SLA tenants informing about possible brief quality change if quantized fallback used.
jin: ACK. I'll take ownership of rack-3 BMC validation before end of day to avoid re-ordering.
ops-oncall: Approved pending network check. I'll standby.
